# ellmos-ai.github.io — LLM Context & Architecture Reference

> Interactive public ecosystem maps, bundle recipes, skill library, and stack composer for the ellmos AI framework.

- **Live Site**: https://ellmos-ai.github.io
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-ai.github.io
- **Organization**: https://github.com/ellmos-ai
- **Umbrella Ecosystem**: https://github.com/open-bricks
- **License**: MIT
- **Current Version**: 0.1.1
- **Last Checked**: 2026-09-10

## Overview

`ellmos-ai.github.io` serves as the official public web gateway to the `ellmos` ecosystem. It presents interactive visual maps, modular recipes, and composition tools for human engineers and autonomous agents alike. All pages are built as self-contained static HTML documents that require no build pipeline in the repository, make no third-party network requests, and execute 100% offline within the client's browser.

## Public Artifacts

| File | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`index.html`](https://ellmos-ai.github.io) | Module Circuit Map | Visual circuit diagram of all public modules categorized by functional domain (DE/EN, dark/light modes). |
| [`bundles.html`](https://ellmos-ai.github.io/bundles.html) | Bundle Recipes | 13 curated composition recipes detailing which modules, skills, and tools form each functional bundle. |
| [`skills.html`](https://ellmos-ai.github.io/skills.html) | Skill Library | Full public skill catalog with inline reader and copy-to-clipboard functionality. |
| [`stack-composer.html`](https://ellmos-ai.github.io/stack-composer.html) | Stack Composer | Interactive canvas to compose custom module stacks with live rule validation and `stack.v2.json` export. |
| [`.nojekyll`](.nojekyll) | NoJekyll Marker | Disables Jekyll processing on GitHub Pages to serve pure static artifacts directly. |

## Maintenance & Automation

The repository contains an idempotent, windowed site maintainer script that syncs public artifacts with upstream catalogs without exposing private or draft modules:

- **Script**: `_tools/pages_maintainer.py`
- **Fallback Documentation**: `_tools/FALLBACK-AUTOMATION.md`
- **Cadence**: 7-day window anchored to Mondays (synchronized with `system-auditor`).
- **Safety Gates**:
  - Verification of skill counts against canonical `.SKILLS` registry.
  - Fail-closed leak-gates detecting private module IDs or draft visibility flags (`vis:"priv"`, `vis:"cand"`).
  - Atomic content checking: Git commits are generated only when verified public site files differ from HEAD.

## Security & Governance Invariants

The project strictly adheres to 10 core runtime and architecture invariants as defined in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md):
1. `INV-STATIC-01`: **100% Static & Zero Network Egress** (zero tracking, zero analytics, zero external HTTP calls, no third-party CDNs).
2. `INV-LEAK-02`: **Fail-Closed Leak-Gates** (strict quarantine and auditing of upstream modules before publication).
3. `INV-CATALOG-03`: **Canonical Catalog Parity** (exact match of skill counts with upstream `.SKILLS`).
4. `INV-RUNAS-04`: **Local-First & Non-Elevation (User Mode)** (runs fully in unprivileged user space under `RunAsInvoker`).
5. `INV-WINDOW-05`: **Deterministic 7-Day Window Cadence** (predictable window bounds, explicit state tracking in `_tools/.state/`).
6. `INV-DIFF-06`: **Atomic Content-Change Commits** (commits generated exclusively when verified site files differ from HEAD).
7. `INV-LOCK-07`: **Fail-Closed Lock Discipline** (honors repository locks `LOCK.pages-maintainer.txt`).
8. `INV-OS-08`: **Multi-OS Platform Parity & Smoke Integrity** (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS across Python 3.10-3.13).
9. `INV-CLIENT-09`: **Pure Client-Side Static Execution** (self-contained HTML/CSS/JS without backend server requirements).
10. `INV-SLA-10`: **48h Security SLA & 5-Day Triage Commitment** (binding SLA for vulnerability acknowledgment and triage).

## Sibling Tools & Ecosystem Matrix

`ellmos-ai.github.io` visually surfaces and interconnects 16 sister repositories across `ellmos-ai`, `dev-bricks`, `file-bricks`, `doc-bricks`, and `open-bricks`:
- `ellmos-ai/coma`: Multi-Agent Job Board & Provider Routing Bridge
- `ellmos-ai/clutch`: Provider-neutral routing for single tasks
- `ellmos-ai/MarbleRun`: Sequential agent loops & chain execution
- `ellmos-ai/policy-registry`: Policy governance & capability permission authority
- `ellmos-ai/system-explorer`: System-wide topology & stack inspection
- `ellmos-ai/sqlite-transit-sync`: Secure SQLite snapshot & sync pipeline
- `ellmos-ai/workflowhooker`: Workflow hooking & lifecycle event interceptor
- `ellmos-ai/memoryhooker`: Agent memory injection & provenance tracking
- `ellmos-ai/swarm_ai`: LLM swarm intelligence & consensus voting toolkit
- `ellmos-ai/ellmos-filecommander-mcp`: Local-First FileCommander MCP Server
- `ellmos-ai/ellmos-codecommander-mcp`: Local-First CodeCommander MCP Server
- `ellmos-ai/ellmos-controlcenter-mcp`: Unified AI Tools & Profiles Control Center MCP
- `dev-bricks/DevCenter`: Developer workstation hub & process control
- `dev-bricks/CodeBox`: Multi-language code runner & plugin platform
- `file-bricks/ProFiler`: Local-First file analysis & privacy traffic light
- `open-bricks/open-bricks`: Umbrella open-source developer tooling ecosystem

## Test Suite & Verification

- **Maintainer Unit Tests**: `tests/test_pages_maintainer.py` (5 tests)
- **Metadata & Contract Tests**: `tests/test_metadata.py` (expanded contract suite)
- **Test Gate**: 100% passing tests via Pytest (`python -m pytest -ra -v`)
- **Linting Gate**: Clean static analysis via `ruff check .` and `python -m compileall`
